name: Adyen N.V.
quirks: Euronext Amsterdam ordinary listing (EUR). 1 ADYEY ADR = 1/100 ordinary share. Half-yearly reporting (H1/H2 shareholder letters; H2 letter carries FY figures) plus revenue-only Q1/Q3 business updates that OVERLAP the halves - never sum them. Balance-sheet cash is mostly MERCHANT SETTLEMENT FLOAT - own cash = cash - payables to merchants + receivables (30-Jun-2026: 12,392.8 - 8,097.4 + 602.8 = EUR4.9bn, ~EUR4.6bn net of the Talon.One/Orb acquisitions, vs the EUR12.4bn headline). No financial debt, only IFRS-16 leases. Revenue column intentionally blank; NetRevenue is the top line. Balance sheet is presented equity-BEFORE-liabilities, so there is no 'Total liabilities' line - it must be derived as assets - equity (the only total after the liability lines is the footing 'Total liabilities and equity', which equals total assets). SBC basis is equity-settled + cash-settled and EXCLUDES the Fixed Salary shares plan. Filings/extracts shared with the ADYEY folder. The H1-2026 letter PDF has corrupt font encoding (pdftotext yields zero digits) - the Extracted .txt is ocrmypdf output.
